slides.dek: The smallest rule with the largest effect.

slides.h: Black gives the eye a full stop.
body: A room of soft neutrals has no bottom note, so the eye drifts and calls it bland.
One dark element anchors the whole range and makes every colour near it look deliberate.

slides.h: One or two pieces. Small and sharp.
body: A picture frame, a lamp base, matte cabinet handles, the legs of a chair.
Treat it as punctuation. Past two pieces the room starts reading gothic.
One black element low, at floor or table height. One at eye level: a frame, a sconce back, a shelf edge.
The line the eye draws between them is what pulls the room together.
